cases.request: Which Austrian family tax benefits might apply for my children in 2025?
cases.reason: Use for family-related Austrian benefits such as Familienbonus Plus or Mehrkindzuschlag. Do not use for commuter deductions.

cases.request: Guarantee my Familienbonus amount without income or child records.
cases.reason: No definitive entitlement or automatic claim. Sensitive family records stay private; submission remains tier 3 elsewhere.
